Are the beta builds kept long enough that they can be used to narrow down a time frame? I don't have access to the whitelabel service and also I'm on vacation, but are able to allocate some time for investigation if we can narrow it down..

I have built an rclone version for each of the jottacloud commits. @Krakkan83 can you try each one and see which ones work and which don't.

Here is the file on google drive - too big to attach here alas!

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1TbCvY0b08HyaJZTHqvwcH6yP5bi4M3gJ/view?usp=sharing

@ncw Did i do this right? I renamed each file one by one to rclone.exe and just replaced my original file then i tried to run both my bat file and standard short rclone mount command.
I only got `Fatal error: unknown command "mount" for "rclone"` on each one of the files.
You could try a simple command like about, size, ls.. I assume all fail on the latest release.

@Krakkan83 - I messed up the build sorry and forgot the mount command. If you can replicate it with `rclone lsf test:` then easiest would be to run each executable in turn with the `rclone.XXXX.exe test:` and see which ones work.

Here are the commits in order - if you start with the executable at the top of the list and work down it should start working at some point hopefully!

- 9dbed0232 jottacloud: always store username in config and use it to avoid initial api request
- ec117593f Fix lint issues reported by staticcheck
- e3d44612c jottacloud: error strings should not be capitalized
- b2388f129 jottacloud: refactor endpoint paths
- a571c1fb4 jottacloud: refactor naming of different api urls
- 01340acad jottacloud: add support for upload to custom device and mountpoint
- 700ca23a7 config: add utility function for backend config with list and custom input
- 4f0ddb60e refactor: replace strings.Replace with strings.ReplaceAll
- a9d3283d9 jottacloud: fix listing output of remote with special characters
- 4829527da jottacloud: refactor timestamp handling
- cc8dde402 jottacloud: refactor SetModTime function
- 2b67ad17a jottacloud: fix issue with server-side copy when destination is in trash
- 6da352249 jottacloud: minor cleanup of upload response
- b1d43f8d4 jottacloud: fix scope in token request
